title: Constraints on converting under-used HDB multi-storey car park spaces for community use
asked: Mr David Hoe asked what constraints, beyond demand, potential disamenities, fire safety, exit capacity and structural loading, may limit converting under-utilised HDB multi-storey car park spaces for community uses, and whether those constraints apply to the MSCP at Clementi Peaks.
response: Ms Sun Xueling said HDB periodically receives requests to repurpose MSCPs, which are built for vehicle parking, and that it evaluates proposals against residents' needs and safety, parking demand over time, potential disamenities, and technical factors including fire safety, exit capacity and structural loading. She said revenue considerations and opportunity costs from forgone income are not a factor in HDB's assessment. For Clementi Peaks, completed in July 2022, she said parking needs have not yet fully stabilised and it is too early to consider converting the spaces. In supplementary replies, she said parking demand can take years to stabilise in a new estate, that MSCP under-utilised spaces are incidental and not designed for community activities, and that HDB can consider repurposing suitable carparks subject to parking needs and technical feasibility.

key_points.point: MSCPs are built for vehicle parking, so HDB would need to carefully evaluate proposals to repurpose them.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: As MSCPs are built for vehicle parking, HDB would need to carefully evaluate proposals to repurpose these MSCPs.

key_points.point: HDB considers residents' needs and safety.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: They have to bear in mind considerations, such as residents' needs and safety.

key_points.point: The assessment includes enough lots to meet parking demand over time, potential disamenities, and technical considerations including fire safety, exit capacity and structural loading.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: The assessment also includes the factors cited by Mr David Hoe, such as having enough lots to meet the demand for parking over time, potential disamenities to residents and technical considerations including fire safety requirements, exit capacity and structural loading.

key_points.point: Revenue considerations and opportunity costs from forgone income are not a factor in HDB's assessment.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: Revenue considerations, including opportunity costs from forgone income that Assoc Prof Jamus Lim mentioned at the COS debate last month, are not a factor in HDB's assessment.

key_points.point: Clementi Peaks was completed less than four years ago in July 2022.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: In the case of Clementi Peaks, the project was completed less than four years ago in July 2022.

key_points.point: Parking needs at Clementi Peaks have not yet fully stabilised, and it is too early to consider converting the parking spaces to other uses.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: Parking needs have not yet fully stabilised and it is too early to consider converting the parking spaces to other uses at this juncture.

key_points.point: Parking demand can change and evolve over time, especially in a new estate.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: parking demand can change and evolve over time, especially in a new estate

key_points.point: HDB does not recommend conversion of parking spaces into alternative uses during the early years of developments.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: HDB does not recommend conversion of parking spaces into alternative uses during the early years of developments

key_points.point: HDB estates are designed with playgrounds, community spaces and open lawns for residents' leisure.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: our HDB estates are designed with playgrounds, with community spaces, with open lawns

key_points.point: Under-utilised space in MSCPs is incidental and not designed and intended for community activities and gatherings.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: For under-utilised space in MSCPs, these are incidental spaces, and they are not designed and intended for community activities and gatherings.

key_points.point: Where the opportunity arises, HDB can consider repurposing suitable carparks into alternative uses, subject to meeting residents' parking needs and technical feasibility.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: where the opportunity arises, HDB can consider repurposing suitable carparks into alternative uses, subject to meeting the parking needs of residents

key_points.point: An HDB email cited considerations including regulatory requirements, fire and safety, building safety standards, suitability of location and potential disamenities to residents.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: there are other considerations, such as regulatory requirements, fire and safety, building safety standards, for instance, suitability of location and potential disamenities to residents that the non-parking uses may create
